rationale: The response maintains the indignant sworn-testimony register throughout, reframing the allegation as more American by claiming the 'football' reference was a cry of passion for the NFL, not soccer. It also addresses the Chair and names a 'true subversive.'
quote: When I yelled, "Come on, that's ruining football!", it was a cry of passion for the gridiron, not an endorsement of the metric system!
